content: Me niŋ adi Bepaŋ’walaŋ kayoŋbop diniŋ kadokome titiŋdok nadikwambundalak adi yadi kwanai loloŋnit titiŋdok dakalelak. Mede woŋ adi biyagoŋ hinek.
Kayoŋbop diniŋ kadokome adi indiŋ hatibune utumbaluwaak:

content.text: adi metam dauhik gineŋ yomnit mokit hatiŋila tam kubugoŋdut hogok hatiluwaak.
didimeniŋgoŋ hatibune metam nolidi kaŋ nadiune utumbaluwaak.
tiŋa undugoŋ weleŋdi muneeŋ wapum moŋgotdok mu nadiluwaak.
adi ne didimeniŋgoŋ hatiŋila ne’walaŋ wapmihi-tam kedemgoŋ yabudokooŋ wapmihiŋiye yehitubu-didimeune gikiŋgoŋ timiŋa medeŋiŋ nadiŋa hatiyaneeŋ.

content: Be adi ne’walaŋ wapmihi-tam kedemgoŋ mu yabudokowaak adi kadoko kwanai diniŋ mebi dediŋ tiŋa nadididimeeŋ Bepaŋ’walaŋ kayoŋbop diniŋ behik tiŋa yabudokowaak.

Niŋ indiŋ, nebek niŋ adi kayoŋbop maaneŋ kobugoŋ tomboyoukuk adi yadi kayoŋbop diniŋ kadokome pilap mu mintawaak. Tiyaugene undiniŋdi sigitiŋalo tubune Bepaŋdi Sadaŋ kelekukuk undugoŋ adi maaŋ kelekulaakneŋ ala.

Me talitimeŋ hatidok adi metam Bepaŋ’walaŋ kayoŋbop gineŋ mu tomboyoukiŋ adi maaŋ kaune tuwot tilak undiniŋ kameune hatiluwaak. Metam kayoŋbop mu tigiŋ undihidi nintiŋafo tubune Sadaŋdi weleŋ tubufilune adi’walaŋ talamutdi begep wele ulaakneŋ.
Kayoŋbop diniŋ tubuloda me heki adi maaŋ undugoŋ me didimehi hatiyaneeŋ. Mebelemhik lufom adi mu moŋgo hatiyaneeŋ. Ime fafaŋehi kisaŋ mu nayaneeŋ. Adi muneeŋ wapumdok nadigalika mu taneeŋ.
Adi yadi yomnit mokit tiŋa welehik adi walaniŋ hatiŋa nadisukiliti mede, kabup hebihali buge buge mintadakaleguk u welehik maaneŋ nadidahi tiyaneeŋ.
Adi timentimeŋ yeniŋkulune kwanai tikatika taneeŋ. Ala kwanaihik kaune tuwot tubune kayoŋbop maaneŋ kwanai folooŋ titiŋdok yenindapmaaŋ yapmeyaneeŋ.

Kaŋ tubuloda me tamhiye be kwanai tam adi maaŋ didimeniŋgoŋ hatiyaneeŋ. Adi yadi metam yeniwoliwolike mu tiyaneeŋ. Adi tobo welehikdi didimeniŋgoŋ nadisuŋa hatiŋila mede yoyohik be titiŋhik didimeniŋgoŋ tubune folooŋnit hogok tuluwaak.
Tiŋa kayoŋbop diniŋ tubuloda me adi undugoŋ, tam kubugoŋdut hatiŋa wapmihi-tam be meŋimeŋiye momooŋgoŋ yabudokoluwaak.
Unduŋ tiŋa adi kwanai momooŋ tubune nadimimbune utumbaune wougigit momooŋ mintawaak. Unduŋ tiŋa Kilisto Jesu nadisukilitimiŋa kwanaiŋiŋ titiŋdok lodahinaka tibaak.
Nu du’walaŋkade agaŋ pilap uuŋdok nadilat iŋgoŋ indiŋ doktiŋa yodidime mede i youkamulat.

Tiyaugene nemek niŋdi nehigiyamneune pilap mu bene Bepaŋ’walaŋ kayoŋbop dediŋ hatidok wendiniŋ mebi mu nadiŋa nadibedi tibaaneŋ yoŋa pepa i youkamulat. Biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, Bepaŋ’walaŋ metamŋiye adi Hatihati Molom diniŋ kayoŋbop. Kaŋ kayoŋbop wendi taka kobumuŋ nabugoŋ unduŋ tiŋa mede biyagoŋ u ulihiune hatak.
Mede Momooŋ kabup hebihali buŋa mintadakaleune nadisukilitiyam wendiniŋ mebi adi fuliŋgoŋ hinek. Mede woŋ adi indiŋ yohautane magaligalik hinek tilak:

content.text: Adi me hinek mintaune metamdi kagiŋ.
Eŋ Uŋgoniŋ Munabulidi mebiŋiŋ tubumintaune aŋelo hekidi kagiŋ.
Eŋ kwetkwet metam gigitŋiŋ yenihautaune nadisukilitimiŋgiŋ.
Kaŋ Bepaŋdi nagilu kunum gineŋ looŋ wougigitŋiŋ loloŋnit tuguk hatilak.
